title: Bash Command Execution Failure in WSL2 with Node v22.14.0
body:
**Bug Description**
None of the bash commands can be executed by the agent or even explicitly. For example, even !ls get stuck on an infinite loop. I'm running on WSL2 with node v22.14.0

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: undefined
- Version: 0.2.9
